ops.body:
Root GO with amendments: implement exact CTPF0003 design in isolated worktree now. Unloaded reaching has_override is an impossible internal state: invariant/panic or type-level required accessor, no new incomplete-notloaded defensive reply; preserve Exceeded incomplete. Add mixed Index/Full singleflight regression: Full waiter joining Index completion must upgrade, not answer compact or loop. Retire old118 entries only under existing owner/adoption locks. Physical disk-cold predicate <8KiB for1MiB irrelevanttext, correct full overrides/observers/corruption/restart/binding. Keep caps/authority/integrity/LRU unchanged. No local builds/tests/prodRPC/push until exact patch+independent review/rootGO. Forge offline, do not wait. Produce candidate patch, not another memo. Root read full design and authorizes source implementation.
Question: Source-backed design is in RUN/native-compact-predicate-facts-design.md (result JSON beside it). Shape: one file per key, format CTPF0003, 136-byte header with two sealed sections (index {inputs,has_error}; text Option<Vec<OverrideEvent>>), entry name carries index_bytes/index_accounted so restart adoption keeps bounded reads. FactsNeed::{Index,Full} derived in query_graph (Full iff has_override is the kind or a declared observer); Index for prepare_graph/warm. lookup(Index) reads exactly 136+index_len and verifies the index seal; Full reads whole file, both seals. Memory: OverrideFacts::{Unloaded,Exceeded,Loaded}; serves() needs is_full() for Full; raw builds write both sections and keep compact facts in memory unless Full requested; root has_override goes through prepared_root_facts(Full). Unchanged: key fields, binding, authority checks, 16 MiB bound, 512 MiB cap, LRU, single-flight; no TTL/flag/Python surface. 6 Rust files (3 production + serves/touch helpers; test fixture literals in ledger tests). Acceptance fixture: ~1 MiB unrelated tool result, post-evict has_tool reads <8 KiB with 0 source bytes; has_override then reads >=1 MiB; equivalence matrix + per-section seal corruption + inherited-entry index read. Authorize the candidate source implementation?
Options: GO: implement as designed (Recommended) | GO with amendments | Hold: root reviews the design first
